name: Tarique Rahman
role: Prime minister of Bangladesh (2026–); BNP chairman
summary: Rahman advocates multiparty government with constitutional checks, private investment and expanded social protection. His national-interest foreign policy accompanies support for multilateral cooperation; religious constitutional commitments coexist with an expressly inclusive conception of citizenship. Promises to protect dissent sit uneasily with restrictions retained by his government.
